name: Wise Lending V2
rootCause: The DeFi lending protocol Wise Lending V2 was exploited via a flash loan attack. The attacker drained approximately $66,000 from the protocol’s pools by exploiting logic vulnerabilities. The incident affected deployments on Ethereum and Arbitrum.

descriptions.text: The DeFi lending protocol Wise Lending V2 was exploited via a flash loan attack. The attacker drained approximately $66,000 from the protocol’s pools by exploiting logic vulnerabilities. The incident affected deployments on Ethereum and Arbitrum.

Wise Lending V2 suffered an exploit on February 28, 2026, draining approximately $66,000 from its pools on Arbitrum and Ethereum. The attack has been classified as an improper access control or protocol logic failure, possibly using a flash loan, but the precise vulnerability and on-chain exploit sequence have not been made public. The exploited vulnerability is classified as improper access control or a protocol-logic flaw, likely involving insufficient validation on a privileged or core function. No public technical postmortem or specific function has been released.
